findings.title: Mission reads are not transactional, so mission row and task list come from separate snapshots
findings.resolution: MissionService.list and get run in one read-only transaction.

findings.title: Unpublishable conflict lists a task that is both draft and graphic twice in the detail
findings.resolution: A task that is both draft and graphic is named once, as a draft; test "a task that is both draft and graphic is named once".

findings.title: FR-12 child-facing scenarios are unverified, yet the plan closes FR-12 in slice 6 and its acceptance contract is artifact-ok
findings.resolution: Carry-over recorded in design.md ("Carry-over to slice 7"): slice 7 serves the child only through ServedContent and adds the HTTP 404 / HQ tests with @trace FR-12; docs/current-state.md lists the child-facing FR-12 scenarios under Scope NOT delivered. The plan row is a docs-store change for the owner.

findings.title: Topic-change refusal is checked before field validation, so a request with field errors can get 409 instead of 400
findings.resolution: Precedence specified in the spec delta and design.md (topic lock before field rules) and pinned by a test (topic change with position 0 is 409).

findings.title: MissionRules.taskStatus takes a `task` parameter it never reads
findings.resolution: MissionRules.taskStatus no longer takes the unused task parameter.

findings.title: 409 `conflicts` for mission-topic-locked and last-task holds the mission's own id, which the contract defines as the blocking entities
findings.resolution: A topic-lock 409 now lists the mission's task ids (the blocking entities); the last-task 409 keeps the published mission id; both stated in the spec delta.
